description: For plumbing call, this inspection checklist records urgency, isolation, diagnosis, repair options, parts, code or permit needs, water-damage concern, and price approval. Its supporting evidence includes leak photos, pressure or flow readings, drain observation, removed-part condition, and post-repair test.

blocks.guidance: Mark each plumbing call item after direct review.
items: Repair area, fixtures, valves, and connections are visibly dry
Flow, pressure, drainage, temperature, or cycling is checked as applicable
Shutoffs and access panels are restored and identified
Affected finishes, cabinets, floors, and contents are checked
Parts, readings, photos, and unresolved conditions are recorded
Customer operating limits and follow-up needs are explained

subtitle: Plumbing Call Inspection Checklist: residential plumbing service call dispatch using fixture or piping, urgency, and leak photos.
title: Plumbing Call Inspection Checklist
use_case: Use the inspection checklist during residential plumbing service call dispatch when the plumbing call record must identify fixture or piping, leak location, shutoff access, water availability, affected rooms, occupancy, and prior repair. Complete the applicable handoff for leak-free test, restored fixtures, customer instructions, damage referral, permit follow-up, and service warranty.
